os_level_isolation.note: No container/isolated-user isolation configured on this host. Per guide 0.2 the lab must NOT claim writes outside LAB_ROOT are impossible; path guards are hygiene only. Untrusted native execution stays out of scope until an OS mechanism exists.

market_execution_note: Market execution stays disabled at LAB-01 exit by design (guide LAB-01 exit gate). It is unlocked only after LAB-02 adapter certification and LAB-03 data qualification.
containment_claim: Path guards + env redirection only. os_level_isolation.available=false on this host, so the lab does NOT claim writes outside LAB_ROOT are impossible.
